fact: The universal access and service fund (FASU) is fed by a 2% contribution on operators' turnover and, per ARCEP in August 2023, spent 6,221,160,031 F CFA on white-zone coverage in 2021-2022 and over 16 billion F CFA toward the national backbone.
title: Bilan des réalisations multisectorielles du Fonds pour l'accès et le service universels
